$description: Stint design tokens — the single source of truth for the visual system (design.html is the normative spec; this file carries the values). W3C DTCG format (stable 2025.10). Layer 1: primitive scales, adopted wholesale from Radix Colors light mode (sand, tomato, red, grass, amber — radix-ui/colors, MIT). Layer 2: semantic tokens, each aliasing one scale step; only semantic tokens may be referenced by mockups and the app. scripts/gen-tokens.mjs generates the CSS custom-property block between STINT-TOKENS markers in every mockup and packages/gui/renderer/styles.css; a guard test asserts parity and the contrast floors in design.html §Accessibility.

semantic.$description: The only tokens surfaces may use. Text tokens meet 4.5:1 on the surfaces design.html permits them on; signal tokens meet 3:1 non-text. faint is never readable text (3.28:1) — decorative and disabled uses only.

sidebar.$description: Nav rail surface — the region reads by layout + rule border; the fill is warmth, not signal.

wash.$description: Sunken component background (segmented track, tags, pills).

rule-strong.$description: Field and control border (fields always carry a visible label — design.html §Accessibility).

faint.$description: Decorative/disabled only. Never readable text; icon-only affordances use muted instead.

accent.$description: The rationed clay signal — icons, running-state marks, focus ring. Non-text only (3.80:1).

accent-solid.$description: Filled primary-action background; its label is on-accent (4.90:1).

accent-weak.$description: Weak accent fill. Not a text surface for accent-ink (4.33:1) — see design.html selection rule.

on-accent.$description: Label on a solid action fill (accent-solid 4.90:1, the filled danger 5.12:1). sand·1, not pure white: a label is a surface, so it stays a one-step scale alias (design.html D01) — indistinguishable from white on the fill.

run.$description: Running-state text (4.98:1 on paper, 4.54:1 on run-weak).

run-dot.$description: The running dot — always paired with a text label.

flag.$description: Warn/advisory text — on paper and on flag-bg (11.17:1 / 10.47:1).

danger.$description: Refused-write/destructive text (5.12:1 on paper, 4.54:1 on danger-weak).

base.$description: Spacing grid unit — every padding, gap, and margin is a multiple (design.html §Layout). Component intrinsic heights are free.

num.$description: Tabular numerals for every clock and duration.

shadow.$description: The warm elevation ladder (chip → card → raise → pop → modal → win). One rung above what a surface covers; never nest cards. chip is not a layer rung — it is the D12 selection lift, below card.

chip.$description: The D12 raised-chip lift — the selection rung below card. It says one thing: this is the chosen one. Nothing merely raised, pressed, dragged, or resting takes it. Its strength is a floor, not taste: below ~.25 alpha with ~4px of reach the lift stops reading at chip size (issue #338's rendered pairs), so design-guard holds the value there.
